text:
marta: heads-up — saw a recurring p99 latency pulse (~40-60ms extra) correlated with kv eviction sweeps when long-context workloads run for >20s at ~1k rps. started ~2h ago.

jonah: hmm. is this the same waveform as yesterday's paging wobble or a new one? any repro link?

marta: new pattern. repro script: `./scripts/repro_kv_pressure --concurrency 32 --context-length 8192 --rps 1000`. attaching small log excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-18T10:02:13Z] evicter: beginning sweep pass id=842
[2026-03-18T10:02:13Z] evicter: scanned 524k entries, reclaimed 0, deferred 412
[2026-03-18T10:02:13Z] evicter: sweep_duration_ms=47
[2026-03-18T10:02:13Z] request: token_emit_p99_ms=12 -> 54
```

jonah: 47ms sweep is bad under p99 SLO. which policy were you running (LRU or FIFO)?

marta: LRU by default. i toggled to FIFO and saw mean drop in p99 by ~8ms but noticed occasional correctness anomalies (reuse counter mismatch) in the FIFO run.

sam: i ran a bisect yesterday. quick summary: LRU -> higher sweep cost because it tries a best-effort reorder/aging pass; FIFO -> cheaper but we have a reinsert path that assumes evictee tombstone invariants which are slightly different (racey). i have perf dumps: 
```
# top of profile during spike
35.2%  runtime  Evicter::sweep_full
18.4%  runtime  KV::reinsert_chain
9.1%   runtime  AllocArena::scan_live
```

rachel: i grabbed a heap+cpu profile from the repro vm. flamegraph shows long flat tail in `reinsert_chain` when contexts exceed 6k tokens. looks like fragmentation leads to extra list traversal.

jonah: could the scan be re-scanning recently-touched slots due to our global watermark reset? i've seen the global watermark update cause redundant passes under heavy allocation churn.

marta: good call. attaching a quick trace of watermark ops during a spike: 
```
[trace] evict_trigger -> compute_hotset -> update_global_watermark (freq=120/s)
[trace] global_watermark_bump causes per-shard sweep kick
```

sam: aha — per-shard sweep kicking frequently means many concurrent sweep goroutines colliding on the arena lock. lock contention + list traversal = latency noise. i repro'd with `--sweep-interval=500ms` and saw the pulses align to sweep starts.

perf-bot: perf/regression-checker: detected +14% p99 on `kv-evict` microbenchmark vs baseline at commit abc123. link: https://perf.internal/reports/kv-evict/abc123

jonah: two-pronged remediation idea: 1) debounce global_watermark updates (coalesce bumps, only propagate if delta > threshold) and 2) convert full-sweep to incremental backoff where each pass only scans N entries and reschedules itself with exponential backoff under high contention.

rachel: incremental backoff sounds promising. downside: increases time-to-reclaim which could raise memory footprint during sustained pressure. we should quantify tradeoffs. i can run a matrix: {sweep_chunk=1k,2k,4k} x {backoff_ms=50,200,800}.

marta: also we need a correctness check for FIFO reinsert path. sam, can you add an assert in dev builds to catch reuse counter mismatch? e.g., `assert(!entry.reuse_stale || in_tombstone_state)` — fail fast in CI.

sam: yes. i'll add guarded asserts and a small fuzz test that interleaves evict+reinsert with skewed timing.

infra-bot: rolled a temporary guard: disabled aggressive sweep on canary hosts (policy set: sweep_max_chunk=2048, sweep_backoff_ms=300). monitoring p99 now.

marta: after guard, p99 dropped ~11ms in canary, and spikes are much less frequent. looks promising.

jonah: plan for next week: 1) rachel runs the sweep matrix and posts data, 2) sam lands FIFO correctness asserts + fuzz test, 3) i prototype incremental sweep with coalesced watermark updates. if results are good, ship as opt-in knob behind feature-flag, then roll to prod.

rachel: starting matrix now, will post CSV and plots + heap delta.

marta: thanks. small note: capture span ids when you post plots so we can correlate with kernel-selection changes; earlier we saw scheduling + kernel switch also briefly amplify this under mixed-precision kernels.

sam: noted. adding extra tracing.

jonah: great thread. tagging @eng-sre for possible rollout coordination next week. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: automated follow-up scheduled in 2h to evaluate canary telemetry.
